401460801.text: Over time, your business continues to grow and expand. Your increasing success means an entirely new business opportunity could be on the horizon...

401460802.text: Oh, a merchant is here. Huh, Paimon's not sure they're from Mondstadt though. Let's go check it out.

401460101.text: Hello there! The name's Atefeh. I'm a traveling merchant from Sumeru. Great to meet you!

401460102.text: Woah, you've made quite the journey! Guess news of our humble shop has already spread to all four corners of Teyvat!

401460104.text: Paimon's practically a sales whiz. She could sell water to a fish, hehe!

401460106.text: Haha, I have to agree! This venture of yours is becoming quite well-known. In fact, many well-informed merchants have heard word of your potion-selling endeavor.

401460107.text: But most people are still not willing to take a risk on such a rare commodity.

401460108.text: If you ask me, though, when opportunity knocks, you've got to be ready to answer. That's how you make the big Mora.

401460109.text: Although the general public still doesn't know much about alchemical potions right now, with a little effort and marketing on your side, you can carve out a nice space in the market for yourself. Once that happens, the Mora will just keep on flowing!

401460110.text: Once you've generated enough demand, you could even increase your prices ten fold... Hehe, with that kind of profit, you could even take the rest of the year off if you wanted.

401460112.text: Hehe, as long as the demand is there, people will pay anything. You could say it's a sort of mutual agreement between consumer and supplier.

401460113.text: With the way you talk, Paimon can't help but be reminded of a certain other Mora-obsessed merchant...

401460114.text: Wait, you did say you were from Sumeru. Maybe you know her. Ever met Dori?

401460115.text: Wait, you mean Lord Sangemah Bay? One of the most famous merchants in all of Sumeru？That Dori? You know her?
